The Problem

A Broken System Costing Millions

The sports and talent agency industry operates in opacity, extracting value through misaligned incentives rather than creating it.

  • $1.37 billion extracted annually in commissions with zero transparency
  • Agents represent both sides — fundamental conflicts of interest in every deal
  • Hidden fees reaching 18–20% in complex multi-party transactions
  • Information asymmetry allows agents to manipulate valuations in their favor
  • Athletes and clubs lose millions to a system designed to obscure, not serve
